pages.title: ORSA Data Slate
pages.text: Each holds one blueprint. Right-click the Fabricator with it to archive it.

pages.title: The Archive
pages.text: The archive belongs to the world, shared by everyone in it. A new slate is used up; one already known stays in your hand.$(br2)The status line says when the inputs match a blueprint you have not archived.

pages.title: Where To Find Them
pages.text: $(li)Helion site log desks: two or three fusion slates$(li)CFU-7 site shift lockers: the radiator slate$(li)Half of Uplink supply drops: one you have not learned

pages.title: Project Icarus
pages.text: Project Icarus is an optional slate for the AMR-1 "Icarus". It does not count toward the Full Archive.
